issuer: Digital Government and Service NL, Motor Registration
note: The Minister's driver fees policy (dated 21 December 2023, from Motor Registration's forms and fees page, read 2026-10-30) gives a 5-year Class 5 licence at $125 ($115 renewed online) and a Photo Identification Card at $25; the photo identification card page says the card is valid for five years. The graduated licensing page has new drivers at least 16, at least 12 months as a learner (8 with an approved course) and 12 months at Level II, so a full licence is kept from 18.

sources.title: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Driver fees policy (21 December 2023)
Motor Registration, Photo Identification Card
sources.said: The ID card is valid for a five year period.

sources.title: Motor Registration, Graduated Driver Licencing Program
sources.said: New drivers must be at least 16 years of age ... spend at least 12 months at this level before taking a road test. ... The Class 5II Novice Driver must spend 12 months at Level II
